name: custom-paste-image
description: Paste a clipboard image straight into a markdown file, with configurable target folder and link style. Reads real image files (not just bitmaps), keeps PNG transparency, and works on Windows, Remote-WSL, and Linux.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Images are written with the file system API and linked by path, so the document has to live on disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: customPasteImage.folder can point outside the workspace, so its workspace value is ignored until you trust the folder.

customPasteImage.folder.markdownDescription:
Where to save the image. Empty saves next to the edited file. A path starting with `/` is relative to the workspace folder root (e.g. `/assets/img`). Anything else is relative to the edited file's directory (e.g. `images` or `../assets`).

**Hugo:** set this to `/static`, `#customPasteImage.linkStyle#` to `workspaceAbsolute` and `#customPasteImage.linkRoot#` to `/static` to get links like `/shot.png`. If the site is in a subfolder of the workspace, include it in both paths, e.g. `/site/static`.

enumDescriptions: Link relative to the edited file, e.g. ./images/name.png

Link with a leading /, e.g. /assets/img/name.png, rooted at the workspace or at customPasteImage.linkRoot. For static sites: with Hugo, set linkRoot to /static so static/name.png is linked as /name.png. Falls back to relative when the image isn't saved inside that root.
customPasteImage.linkStyle.description: How the inserted link is written.

customPasteImage.linkRoot.markdownDescription: With `#customPasteImage.linkStyle#` set to `workspaceAbsolute`: the workspace folder that `/` in a link stands for. Empty means the workspace root. For Hugo, set `/static` together with `#customPasteImage.folder#` `/static`, so `static/shot.png` is linked as `/shot.png` (`/site/static` for both if the site is in a subfolder). Images saved outside this folder get a relative link.

customPasteImage.confirmFileName.description: Ask for the file name before saving. The suggested name comes from the copied file, the selected text, or the current time.

enumDescriptions: — lets you set a size
customPasteImage.format.description: What to insert into the document.
